invariants.rule: equity equals cash plus authoritative marked position value or futures unrealized PnL
signed position equals ordered signed accepted fill quantities
a reversal realizes the old side before opening residual opposite quantity at the new reference basis
gross_result equals realized plus settlement transfers plus funding; net equals gross_result minus costs
commission, exchange fee, and accepted-fill slippage sum exactly and each immutable economic identity applies once
verified variation settlement moves unrealized PnL to cash and resets basis without changing equity
funding is perpetual-only, synchronized, lineage-verified, and applied once
all economic values are finite Decimal and fills/marks/settlements use verified tick and quantity grids
effective clearing and customer margin remain separately attributed; breach facts create no orders
identical ordered event bytes produce identical snapshot bytes and checkpoint resume state
one ledger cannot mix markets, instruments, contracts, currencies, effective versions, or v1 fills
an open end-of-data position remains explicit and fails the completed-run gate
